nodes.strategic_reason: The trajectory shows a technology/economy/production opening with ground units. Supported synergies (Marine-SiegeTank, Reaper-Marine, SiegeTank-Reaper) indicate a flexible ground composition that can handle various threats while maintaining economic growth.
nodes.title: Technology/Economy/Production Opening with Ground Macro Posture
nodes.trajectory_interpretation: Human trajectories show a heavy economy and production opening with ground units, consistent with a technology/economy/production posture. The presence of Marine, Reaper, Factory, Starport, and SiegeTank cues supports a flexible ground army.
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a mid-game composition that leverages ground synergies while maintaining tech and economy; be ready to adapt to opponent's tech or air transitions.
nodes.trigger_summary: Early game, both sides ground-leaning with heavy economy and production; opponent technology light or uncertain, own technology heavy.

opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order.
opening.opening_summary: This opening emphasizes a balanced development of technology, economy, and production infrastructure, aiming to establish a strong macro foundation while remaining adaptable to opponent actions. The strategy leans towards a ground-based army composition with a heavy economic focus, allowing for flexible transitions based on scouting information.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a technology / economy / production posture while preserving flexibility for live observation-driven adaptation.
